view.description: Zero-friction field sales OS: daily planning cockpit, installed-base map, Free Site Audit that trains the rep, and a lightweight leadership dashboard — so the right sales behavior is the easy path.

memory.content: Core thesis: plant and site visits primarily drive aftermarket and relationship value. A Free Site Audit is the non-salesy door-opener. The interactive audit form is the primary forced-learning mechanism. Complete data capture with almost zero admin effort frees brainpower for high-value work and creates real accountability.

Philosophy: eliminate dumb wasted time with no-paper field capture. The workflow itself is the training. Salesperson stays fully autonomous — system suggests, human decides. Draft-only for any external customer email until the owner explicitly widens that. No live GPS tracking of salespeople.

Phase 1 success bar: open to fully prepared calling and scheduling posture in under 5 minutes; warm-call outcomes and completed audits produce clean CRM records with near-zero manual typing; leadership reaction includes powerful, easy, and this changes how we work.

Live Grok Bot team pattern: Daily Coach (planning cockpit) + Audit Agent (forced learning) + Installed-Base Map + President Dash, orchestrated by a Chief of Staff. Connect CRM, calendar, and maps after install. Use synthetic demo data until the owner supplies real records.
